name: Elliptical
instructions: Step onto the pedals and hold the handles lightly.
Start moving in a smooth, fluid motion, standing tall.
Set a resistance that lets you keep a steady pace.
Keep your weight through your whole foot and your shoulders relaxed.
Finish with a few minutes of easy movement to cool down.
longevityNotes: Cardiovascular fitness is the single strongest predictor of a long, active life. Regular cardio work keeps the heart, lungs, and brain in shape for decades.
overview: Low-impact cardio on an elliptical trainer that spares the joints while raising your heart rate.

commonMistakes: Using too much resistance and jerking
safetyNotes: Hold a handle when stepping on or off; stop if you feel dizzy or chest pain.
